sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Pawankumar Dubey
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Vikas Budhwar,J.
1.

Sri Pawan Kumar Dubey, learned counsel for the applicant submits that though the present application under Section 528 of the B.N.S.S. has been filed by the applicant to quash the order of non-bailable-warrants as well as process Under Section 82 of Cr.P.C. & N.S. dated 29.10.2024 passed by Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate-1st, Shahjahanpur in Complaint Case No. 1150 of 2004 (State Vs. Chhotelal and others), Under Section-7(1)/16 (1) and 17 (1) Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954, Police Station G.R.P., District-Shahjahanpur, however non bailable warrants and proceedings under Section 82 of the Cr.P. C. have already been initiated.
He further submits that the applicant shall file an application for recalling of the said order and till the said application is decided protection be accorded.
2. Sri Moti Lal, learned AGA has no objection to the same.

3. Considering the submissions so made across the bar, the application stand disposed of directing the applicant to submit an appropriate application for recalling of non-bailable warrants by 14.8.2025 and on the said motion the court below shall decide the same strictly in accordance with law with most expedition.
